name: Personal Information Protection - Security Safeguards
what_it_decides: Mandates that personal identifiable information (PII) must be protected by security safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information, including end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit.

name: CRA GST/HST Invoicing Documentation Threshold
what_it_decides: Determines mandatory invoice detail thresholds: commercial transactions of CAD 150.00 or higher require recipient/buyer legal name and full address for input tax credit (ITC) validity.

name: CCCS Privileged Account Access Authentication
what_it_decides: Requires multi-factor authentication (MFA) with FIPS 140 validated cryptographic tokens for all administrative, developer, and privileged account sessions accessing financial or sensitive client ledgers.

name: TBS Directive on Automated Decision-Making (ADM) Governance
what_it_decides: Requires explicit human-in-the-loop audit checkpoints and explainability disclosures for high-impact algorithmic, scoring, and automated account actions.
